policies.name: document_submission_files_self_or_admin
policies.qual:
(current_user_is_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (document_submissions ds
     JOIN organization_profiles op ON ((op.id = ds.organization_id)))
  WHERE ((ds.id = document_submission_files.submission_id) AND ((op.user_id = auth.uid()) OR (ds.submitted_by = auth.uid()))))))
policies.check:
(current_user_is_admin() OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (document_submissions ds
     JOIN organization_profiles op ON ((op.id = ds.organization_id)))
  WHERE ((ds.id = document_submission_files.submission_id) AND ((op.user_id = auth.uid()) OR (ds.submitted_by = auth.uid()))))))

policies.name: document_submissions_self_or_admin
policies.qual:
(current_user_is_admin() OR (submitted_by = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = document_submissions.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid())))))
policies.check:
(current_user_is_admin() OR (submitted_by = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = document_submissions.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid())))))

policies.name: organization_renewals_insert_owner
policies.check:
((status = 'draft'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = organization_renewals.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid())))))

policies.name: organization_renewals_select_owner
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = organization_renewals.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid()))))

policies.name: organization_renewals_update_owner
policies.qual:
((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'needs_revision'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = organization_renewals.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid())))))
policies.check:
((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'submitted'::text, 'resubmitted'::text])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM organization_profiles op
  WHERE ((op.id = organization_renewals.organization_id) AND (op.user_id = auth.uid())))))
